label: Fires at D1 after rewarded rare a2->S1, stronger if S2 believed good and prior trial rewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_cover ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec
explanation: Silent at GO and D2. At D1 it fires almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded, the model-based switch-to-a1 signal; this indicator alone gives dev R^2 0.55 beyond timing. Within those trials, magnitude is larger when the ideal observer still favours S2 as good (negative weight on belief_lo, i.e. the rare reward is surprising) and when the trial before was also rewarded (+0.55). Other last-trial patterns, including a1 S1 r, contribute nothing. Free fit (adds state/action of trial -2, belief_cover, episode decile) adds only about 0.01 dev R^2 over the short form. Observed-only; no future variables.

issues: Label wording 'prior trial rewarded' is ambiguous: the trigger trial (a2->S1) is itself the prior trial and is always rewarded. The term is tv('reward',-2)==1, the trial before that one. The revised label says so.

The claims hold on test (--short). The last_is('a2 S1 r') indicator alone gives 0.523. Adding belief_lo gives 0.698 (weight -0.28, so firing is stronger when S2 is believed good). Adding only reward(-2) gives 0.663 (weight +0.84). The full short form gives 0.744, well above the 0.61 additive ceiling. Swapping in action(-2)==2 or state(-2)==2 for reward(-2) does worse (0.700 / 0.698), so the reward claim is specific.

The linear belief_lo term over-penalises cases where S1 is strongly believed good. Misses show D1 firing at 1.97 against a prediction of 0.16 after consecutive a2 S1 r trials. Bounded belief does slightly better (0.746), and (belief_lo<0) does worse (0.732), so this is a mild shape issue, not a missing variable.

Remaining misses are scattered: D1 cells at the window start where the previous trial is unknown ('?'), and occasional firing after a1 S1 r. The mean D1 over-prediction on other patterns is only about 0.04, with no large systematic error class.
No future variables are used. The feature is silent at GO and D2, as claimed.
